"''Only a master of evil, Darth.|Darth Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi in ''A New Hope''|{{Film|IV}}}} '''''Master of Evil''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' hardcover [[canon]] novel that was written by [[Adam Christopher]] and published by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[November 11]], [[2025]] alongside an [[Master of Evil (audiobook)|audiobook version]]. Prior to its title reveal, it was codenamed "Nauset Lighthouse" on Random House's website.{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/762382/nauset-lighthouse-by-random-house-worlds|text=Nauset Lighthouse|oldversion=20250326182905}} The book was first teased as "''Master of Evil''" via a listing on Random House Worlds' website before receiving a formal reveal on [[April 10]], 2025, via [[StarWars.com]] ahead of [[Celebration Japan (2025)|Celebration 2025]]. The novel is focused upon the dark journey of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in the time between [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'' Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The story features Vader on the haunting quest to overcome [[death]] itself, a power first promised to him by his [[Sith Master]] [[Darth Sidious]] when he first fell to the [[dark side of the Force]].{{Film|III}} The book is notable for being the first Vader-focused novel in ten years after [[2015]] saw the release of ''[[Lords of the Sith]]''.{{Bluesky|darthinternous.bsky.social|post/3lmhu6ftz3k2u|[[Tom Hoeler]]|date=2025-02-27|quote=It's been 10 years (2015 - Lords of the Sith) since we've had a proper Darth Vader #StarWars novel. We figured it was time enough at last to change that. INCREDIBLE artwork by Simon Goinard - with kind of a cool story attached to it.}} Christopher described the novel as "a journey to the dark side"{{Bluesky|adamchristopher.me|post/3lmhsgjkxw22g|[[Adam Christopher]]|date=2025-04-10|quote=Let's take a journey to the dark side together… Presenting STAR WARS: MASTER OF EVIL! Out November 11th from Random House Worlds.}} and a big deal for him personally.{{Bluesky|adamchristopher.me|post/3lmi2zw2l7s2z|[[Adam Christopher]]|date=2025-04-10|quote=Hi hi! I'm on my way to Japan, so am not able to reply to everyone individually at the moment. But just to say thanks to everyone! MASTER OF EVIL is a big book for me, and I'm glad people are excited to read it. Heck, I'M excited for YOU to read it! More to come at Star Wars Celebration Japan!}} The novel's title has its roots in ''A New Hope'', within which [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] rebuke's Vader's claim of having become a "master" by decrying him as having only become "a master of evil." ''Master of Evil'' connects with [[Charles Soule]]'s series [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2017)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'' (2017)]], and fills in a gap in one of the series' timeline jumps,{{SWYouTube|q0trVP56Cy0|Star Wars Celebration LIVE! 2025 - DAY 2}} taking place over the course of issues [[Darth Vader (2017) 5|five]] and [[Darth Vader (2017) 6|six]].
